newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX natgas ends down but holds technical range.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX natgas ends down but holds technical range.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natgas futures, shrugging off reports of firmer physical prices, mostly ended lower Monday in sluggish trade, hit by technical selling when upside momentum stalled early in the session.
July slipped 4.8 cents to close at $2.14 per million British thermal units after stalling early at $2.195. August settled 3.4 cents lower at $2.164. Others ended steady to off.

"They couldn't rally it early, then we fell through minor support and they sold it. I think you have to look at the downside now," said one Midwest trader, adding fairly mild extended weather forecasts offered little hope for the bulls.

While Midwest and Northeast temperatures will climb to above-normal by midweek, the heat wave is expected to be short-lived, and most of the nation is forecast to range from normal to slightly-below normal right into next week.
But while forecasts have dimmed hopes for a hot weather rally, some expect wider front-to-back spreads to continue to encourage injections and partly offset the bearish weather patterns.

Technical traders said the lack of conviction about market direction kept many sidelined. Support and resistance in July was still seen at $2.10 and $2.25, respectively. Stronger buying was expected at $2.08, with further resistance at $2.37 and then at the contract high of $2.44.

In the cash, swing gas at the Louisiana Gulf firmed slightly Monday to the high-teens. Midcon pipes were little changed in the low-$2s. New York city gate gas gained about five cents on the heat to the mid-$2.40s.
The NYMEX 12-month Henry Hub strip fell by 1.9 cents to $2.237. NYMEX said 28,850 contracts traded, up from Friday's revised tally of 23,868.

On the KCBT, July finished two cents lower at $2.015, while deferreds ended down by one-half to two cents. The East/West spread narrowed by 2.8 cents to 12.5 cents (NYMEX premium). KCBT said 297 lots traded, up from Friday's total of 149.
